highlights: FLUX 3 Image Klein 开放权重，主打图像编辑、文本生图与最多 10 张参考图合成，并提供 ComfyUI 打包版本。
MemT-1.0-Pro 把动态记忆做成模型原生能力，在 128K 历史长度下相对完整上下文 KV cache 省下约 66× 存储。
智谱系开源医疗多模态模型 LingSante-3.1-air-VL 采用 MoE，124B 总参数、每 token 激活 5.5B，支持 256K 上下文。

items.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein 发布开放权重图像模型
items.summary: Black Forest Labs 推出 FLUX 3 Image Klein，一个 5.6B 开放权重模型，可在同一模型里完成图像编辑、文本生图与最多 10 张参考图合成，并支持用 bounding box 引导布局，文本编码器为 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct。官方同时提供面向 ComfyUI 的重打包仓库，包含 BF16、int8 与 NVFP4 版本，int8 文件可在 8 GB 显存的 RTX 3070 上运行。

evidence.quote: FLUX 3 Image Klein is a 5.6B open weights model designed for image editing.
Edit from an instruction, generate images from text, combine up to 10 references, or guide layouts with bounding boxes.
Editing, text-to-image and multi-reference compositions run through the same model, with Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct as the text encoder.
The 5.6B parameter label refers to the image transformer; the text encoder is separate.

This repository holds the model files repackaged for ComfyUI : the distilled and base transformers in BF16, int8 and NVFP4, the text encoder in BF16 and int8, the prompt upsampler in BF16, int8 and w4a8, and the image autoencoder.
The int8 files run on 8 GB GPUs such as the RTX 3070, and on GPUs without FP8 support (RTX 30 series and older).

items.title: MemT-1.0-Pro 发布，记忆成为模型原生能力
items.summary: MemTensor 发布 MemT-1.0-Pro，将动态本地记忆与可训练的超记忆整合进模型计算，在推理时无需访问原始上下文即可保留并利用历史信息。其持久状态大小恒定，在 128K 历史长度下相比完整上下文 KV cache 减少约 66× 存储。该模型基于 NVIDIA Nemotron 骨干，权重规模为 565B params，可通过 Transformers、vLLM 与 SGLang 使用。

evidence.quote: 🚀🚀 We are happy to announce the release of MemT-1.0-Pro [MemT × NVIDIA]!
MemT-1.0 is a new generation of memory foundation models that makes persistent, dynamically evolving memory an intrinsic part of model computation.
MemT-1.0 integrates dynamic local memory and trainable hyper memory to retain and leverage historical information without accessing original context at inference.
Its persistent state remains constant in size, reducing storage by approximately 66× versus full-context KV cache at 128K history length.
Introduce MemT-1.0 with improved memory storage and utilization, and Mixture-of-Storage (MoS) for scalable memory capacity.
Safetensors Model size 565B params Tensor type BF16 · F32 · Chat template Files info Inference Providers NEW Text Generation This model isn't deployed by any Inference Provider.

items.title: LingSante-3.1-air-VL 开源医疗多模态 MoE 模型
items.summary: 蚂蚁集团医疗团队开源 LingSante-3.1-air-VL，这是其首个开源的大型多模态医疗模型，基于 Ling-3.0-flash-VL，拥有 124B 参数、每 token 激活 5.5B，支持 256K-token 上下文。模型面向影像报告生成、多模态健康评估、医学检索与证据综合、医疗 GUI 代理四类场景，官方同时给出 SGLang 与 vLLM 部署方式，并强调其为研究模型、不可独立诊断。

evidence.quote: LingSante-3.1-air-VL is a lightweight, natively multimodal mixture-of-experts (MoE) model for real-world healthcare.
Built on Ling-3.0-flash-VL , it has 124B parameters and 5.5B active parameters per token .
It accepts text and images and supports 256K-token context window .
It is the first large multimodal medical model that Ant Group's healthcare team has released as open source.

The model's four clinical focus areas are medical imaging reports , multimodal health assessment (skin disease recognition, dietary and nutritional analysis, and medical report interpretation), medical search and evidence synthesis , and medical GUI agents .
LingSante-3.1-air-VL is a research model and is not a medical device.
The LingSante-3.1-air-VL runtime includes native multimodal support, MTP (NEXTN) speculative decoding, and long-context optimizations.

items.title: GigaChat 4 开放 37B-A4B 混合架构 MoE 权重
items.summary: GigaChat 4-37B-A4B 权重上线 Hugging Face，采用 MoE 架构并融合 DeepSeek Sparse Attention 与 Gated DeltaNet，总参数 37B、每 token 激活 4B，上下文窗口达 1,048,576 tokens。该模型在同一 checkpoint 内支持 instant 与 reasoning 两种模式，可按请求切换，并提供递归 MTP 与 DFlash2 两种推测解码方式，官方给出基于 SGLang 的部署脚本。

evidence.quote: GigaChat 4 37B-A4B is a compact hybrid model in the GigaChat 4 family.
It combines a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) and Gated DeltaNet (GDN) with 37B total parameters and 4B active parameters per token.
The model supports multilingual conversation, multi-step agentic tasks, tool calling, structured outputs, mathematical reasoning, coding, and question answering over long documents.
Unlike GigaChat 3.5, which offered separate instant and reasoning checkpoints, GigaChat 4 supports both modes within a single model, selectable per request.
It features a one-million-token context window and supports speculative decoding with either a recurrent MTP drafter or a separate DFlash2 drafter.
1,048,576 tokens
GigaChat 4 is natively supported in SGLang , including recurrent MTP and DFlash2 speculative decoding, per-request instant/reasoning mode selection, and tool calling.
The FP8 model can be deployed on a single H100 80GB GPU (TP1).

items.title: Ming-Image-0.2-Design 开源升级版设计生图模型
items.summary: inclusionAI 升级并开源 Ming-Image-0.2-Design，新版本改善了复杂构图、光照与文字渲染，可用于电商主图、UI 设计草稿与空间渲染。相比上一代分层模型，它把设计图分解进一步细化到角色部件层级，为下游编辑与动画提供素材，官方建议配合结构化提示词与 prompt enhancer 使用。

improves complex composition, lighting, and text rendering, and can be used to

This upgrade further

items.title: Haru-4B 开源全双工语音对话基础模型
items.summary: Haru-4B 是一个低延迟、多语言的全双工连续语音对话基础模型，可同时听与说，每 133 ms 处理一帧用户音频并生成自己的音频与文本，采样频率为 7.5 Hz。音频以每帧 64 维隐变量表示，由 MLP head 以 MeanFlow 一步采样得到，没有独立音频 Transformer，也不用离散音频 token；模型基于 Qwen3.5-4B 文本骨干，约 12 GB 显存即可运行。

evidence.quote: Haru-4B is a low-latency and multilingual full-duplex continuous spoken dialogue foundation
model: it listens and speaks at the same time, the way people do on a phone call.
Native full-duplex at 7.5 Hz.
Every 133 ms the model takes one frame of the user's audio
and produces one frame of its own audio and text.
Continuous audio, one sampling step.
Audio is a 64-dimensional latent per frame.
With an NVIDIA GPU (about 12 GB of memory):
Qwen3.5-4B text backbone, 32 layers, hidden size 2560

items.title: Inworld 开源 48 kHz 人声分离模型
items.summary: Inworld 开放 Apache-2.0 协议的 Voice Isolator v1，面向嘈杂录音与实时音频做人声隔离，提供离线与实时两个 checkpoint 共用一套架构：离线版按 8 s 分块处理，实时版为因果流式，带 20 ms 前瞻、算法延迟 63 ms。模型可从输入中减去分离出的人声以提取背景噪声或伴奏残差，但不能做说话人挑选，也不修复录音中已丢失的频段。

evidence.quote: Open-license (Apache-2.0) 48 kHz voice isolation for noisy speech recordings and live audio.
Inworld Voice Isolator v1 ships as two models that share one architecture:
offline: every frame sees its whole 8 s chunk
a causal stream with 20 ms of look-ahead
Subtract the isolated voice from the input to extract background noise or a backing-track residual for vocals/music separation.
They are not a speaker selector or a restoration model.
The realtime model, voice-isolator-v1-realtime , is causal, with a trained look-ahead of 0, 20 or 40 ms; its algorithmic latency is 63 ms at 20 ms of look-ahead.

items.title: Stable GDN-2 解决线性注意力长上下文训练状态爆炸
items.summary: 论文 Stable Gated DeltaNet-2 把 GDN-2 长上下文训练失败归因于擦除操作在读取与修改方向上的不对称，导致非正态擦除算子的方向增益跨 token 累积，触发状态指数增长。论文提出对称擦除与衰减调节的残差写入方案，在保留分块并行计算的同时给出 O(T) 的状态增长上界；在约 1.6B 参数模型上，128K RULER 平均分较 GDN-2 提升 6.80 分。

evidence.quote: Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) introduces independent channel-wise control over erasure and writing, enhancing state-update expressiveness and in-context retrieval, yet it suffers from training failures during long-context training.

We trace these failures to the asymmetry between reading and modification directions during erasure, which yields non-normal erase operators whose directional gains accumulate across tokens, triggering exponential state growth even without new writes.
To resolve this, we propose Stable GDN-2, employing symmetric erasure to ensure non-expansive state propagation and decay-regulated residual writing to preserve writing flexibility.

T h e o r e t i c a l l y , w e e s t a b l i s h a n O ( T ) u p p e r b o u n d o n r e c u r r e n t s t a t e g r o w t h w h i l e r e t a i n i n g c h u n k w i s e p a r a l l e l c o m p u t a t i o n .
Experiments on ~1.6B parameter models show that Stable GDN-2 achieves stable training alongside improved long-context retrieval.
Compared to GDN-2, it boosts the 128K average RULER score by 6.80 points in the recurrent setting and average accuracy across nine downstream tasks by 0.62 points in the hybrid setting.

items.title: OS-Omni 评测跨平台长程计算机操作智能体
items.summary: OS-Omni 是一个跨平台计算机操作智能体基准与执行环境，覆盖 Windows、Ubuntu、macOS、iOS、Android 与 Web，首版 v1 包含每个平台 48 个任务以及 12 个桌面与 Android 手机配对的跨平台工作流。人工研究显示任务平均需要 67.54 次交互，显著高于 OSWorld 参考的 15.0 次；v1 上最强的 Claude Opus 5.5 平均成功率为 68.5%，落后 77.3% 的人类参考 8.8 分。

evidence.quote: We introduce OS-Omni, a live cross-platform benchmark and execution environment for evaluating computer-using agents across Windows, Ubuntu, macOS, iOS, Android, and Web environments.

OS-Omni is released in versioned waves of 300 tasks each; this paper focuses on the first release, v1, which contains 48 tasks per platform and 12 cross-platform workflows that pair a desktop with an Android phone.

OS-Omni provides reproducible initialization, platform-specific adapters , trajectory logging , and executable final-state evaluators , and includes controlled service-backed applications for workflows involving account, cart, budget, calendar, message, and other persistent state .
Human studies show that OS-Omni tasks require 67.54 interaction steps, substantially exceeding OSWorld references of 15.0 steps.

On v1, the strongest evaluated agent, Claude Opus 5.5, reaches 68.5% average success, trailing the 77.3% human reference by 8.8 points; the gap is uneven across platforms, with frontier models exceeding humans on Linux but trailing them by more than 25 points on iOS and macOS.

items.title: 编码智能体在视觉推理上超过视频生成模型

items.title: ShowNow 让交互式世界模型提前备好候选未来
items.summary: ShowNow 提出细粒度推测式流式框架，在播放期间利用空闲算力预先准备动作条件化的未来视频，把输入到显示的延迟从响应路径上移开。论文报告在单张 H100 上其 5B 模型可维持 480p、16 fps 并准备八个未来；ViZDoom 环境下完整部署将输入到显示的中位延迟从 620 ms 降至 208 ms，重启空帧比例从 1.56% 降到 0.09%。代码、权重与数据集均以 Apache 2.0 发布。

evidence.quote: We introduce ShowNow, a fine-grained speculative streaming framework that uses computation available during playback to prepare action-conditioned futures before input arrives.
Single-latent commitment enables frequent decisions, while configurable preparation covers one to eight actions.
On a single H100, our 5B model sustains 480p generation at 16 fps with eight prepared futures.
In ViZDoom, the complete ShowNow deployment reduces median input-to-display latency from 620 to 208 ms relative to the native-block SolarWM-FT deployment.
Matched-policy experiments reduce restart empty ticks from 1.56% to 0.09% (94%) and improve on-time responses to action changes.
Everything is open-sourced under Apache 2.0:
Model (ShowNow-5B-8F): https://huggingface.co/songyiren/ShowNow-5B-8F
Dataset (ShowNow-MultiFuture, 21,964 8-future forks): https://huggingface.co/datasets/songyiren/ShowNow-MultiFuture

items.title: DRBench Pro 按知识覆盖评测深度研究智能体

items.title: Vernier 揭示时序预测榜单的分辨率不足
items.summary: 论文提出榜单分辨率这一概念：它衡量一个榜单的数据集能分辨多小的分数差距，并据此发布工具 Vernier，可基于榜单已公开的文件计算该指标。GIFT-Eval 能分辨 6.8 个名次，而相邻名次分差为 0.91，其前十名跨度不足两个可分辨步长；四个榜单上按全体参赛者排名的规则翻转了 43 对前十名组合，且没有任何一项被重新评测。

evidence.quote: We call that quantity the resolution of a board and introduce Vernier , a tool that computes it from the files a board already publishes.
Vernier also reports which entries a board cannot separate from its leader and whether its order changes when unrelated parties submit.
GIFT-Eval resolves 6.8 rank places , and its displayed neighbours sit 0.91 apart.
The ten places of its top ten hold fewer than two resolvable steps.
Below the resolution the order depends on who else submitted: across four boards, rules that rank against the pool reversed 43 top-ten pairs with neither entry rerun, in one update in seven.

We release Vernier , which runs this report with one command on any leaderboard that publishes per-dataset scores : https://github.com/therealram18/ vernier View arXiv page View PDF GitHub 10 Add to collection Community Skider Paper author Paper submitter about 22 hours ago A foundation model for ti

items.title: ProxyGenBench 评测结构代理引导的视频生成
items.summary: ProxyGenBench 研究视频生成器跟随动画化 3D blockout 的能力，把要求拆成保留结构、补全缺失内容并纠正代理伪影、把文本图像音频条件绑定到正确实体与事件三类。基准包含来自 60 个场景、三类场景任务的 312 个评测用例，控制代理保真度、文本细节与多模态输入的变化，并使用逐例核对的 checklist 评测五个视频生成器。

evidence.quote: Structural proxies , such as animated 3D blockouts , guide generation by specifying scene layout, motion, camera behavior, and event order.

Successful proxy-guided generation must therefore Preserve intended structure, Complete missing content and correct proxy artifacts, and Bind text, image, and audio conditions to the right entities and events.

We introduce ProxyGenBench to study these interacting requirements, with 312 evaluation cases from 60 scenes across three scene tasks and controlled variations in proxy fidelity , text detail, and multimodal inputs .
We evaluate five video generators using verified, case-specific checklists.
Experiments show that proxies improve spatiotemporal control , but greater proxy detail can coincide with poorer completion, while strong structural adherence does not ensure correct binding.

items.title: Hugging Face 用 Trainium3 跑通 LTX-2.5 视频生成
items.summary: Hugging Face 团队借助 AWS 的 Trainium3 机器，用 diffusers 把 Lightricks 的 LTX-2.5 跑上 NeuronCore：通过张量并行与序列并行在 32 个核心上完成推理，模型加载后生成一段带声音的 10 秒片段用时 22 到 23 s，分辨率为 2048×1024。其为影片编排的 Python 代码约 160 行，示例工程与样片已放在 dacorvo/video-generation。

evidence.quote: I picked LTX-2.5 from Lightricks, which generates video and sound together.
By the end, once the models were loaded, a 10-second clip with sound took 22 to 23 s to generate, on half of the machine.
In the end, the setup matches it, and even beats it by about a second: 22 to 23 s for a 10-second clip at 2048×1024, once the models are loaded, on half of the machine.

The film part is about 160 lines of Python on top: read the film file, order the shots so each keyframe exists before the shot that needs it, and cut the frames to hand over; then trim, caption, even out the sound and assemble the film.
The code is in dacorvo/video-generation .

Getting there took three kinds of work: making the model run on the NeuronCores (requires tensor parallelism), splitting it over more of them (sequence parallelism), and making the host keep up with them.
TP-4 × SP-8: 32 cores on one clip.
Stage 2 runs on 4 × 8 = 32 cores, at 3.0 s a step

items.title: ollama v0.40.19 发布，更新推理与历史缓冲
items.summary: ollama 发布 v0.40.19，主要变更包括 inkling2 面向短历史的加速、draft proposals 与 conv snapshots，以及 mlxrunner 精简 Engram 历史缓冲，另有 llama-server 版本更新。

evidence.quote: inkling2: faster short histories, draft proposals and conv snapshots by @dhiltgen in #19881
mlxrunner: compact Engram history buffers by @pdevine in #19913
bump llama-server by @pdevine in #19917

items.title: Latent Space 播客讨论 AI 训练数据市场
items.summary: G2i 创始人 Gabe Greenberg 讲前沿实验室如何决定购买训练数据：独家数据更贵，竞争对手也能买到的数据则走折扣；好任务应略微超出模型当前能力，需资深工程师设计任务、挑选起始数据并构建 verifier。

evidence.quote: ← The conversations Latent Space Podcast Inside the AI Training Data Market — Gabe Greenberg, G2i A frontier lab can pay more for training data it gets to keep exclusive, or take a discount on data another lab can buy too.

At AI Engineer CODE, G2i founder Gabe Greenberg tells swyx how labs make that decision, how small pilot orders turn into bigger engagements, and when it makes sense to build a data operation in-house.
A good training task should sit just ahead of what a model can do today.
Gabe explains how senior engineers design the task, choose the starting data, and build a verifier that can score the result.
